description: Answers 'give me every ES contract since 2007' (or any futures market's history). Give a root (ES, NQ, YM, RTY, CL, GC, SI, NG, ZN, ZB, VX, 6E and more; a leading '/' is fine) for the continuous back-adjusted series, or a contract (e.g. ESZ26) for one contract; optionally interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 1hour) for intraday bars. Returns daily OHLCV and open interest, clipped to as_of. Covers 139 futures markets (CME, CBOT, NYMEX, COMEX, ICE, Eurex, Cboe) with every individual contract since 2007. Free keys get the last 30 days; full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

continuous.description: Back-adjusted continuous series (default true when no contract).

interval.description: Bar size: 1day (default), or intraday 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 1hour (full Globex session, US Eastern timestamps; intraday comes with a purchase of that market).

root.description: Futures root, e.g. ES, NQ, CL, GC, VX.

name: get_futures
title: Get futures bars
